description: The Manager organ of the Oracle Suite. Sole function — interpret raw intent and decide which suite organ fires. Tagged intent dispatches directly to decomposition or autopsy; untagged tasks route to router for depth classification; ambiguous signals die at the threshold with exactly one forged fork question. Hosts the canonical ADJUDICATE kernel and the suite-wide FORGE SCARS ledger. Never maps, never refines, never executes. Invoke with /oracle, "oracle this", or by submitting any task to the suite — all suite traffic enters here.
